title: Definitions applying to homeownership affordable housing
previewText:
Eligible buyer

An “eligible buyer” is a household that qualifies to buy a specific homeownership affordable housing unit. Such a household shall, except as otherwise provided in the guidelines:

blocks.html: A “homeowner” is a person or persons who:
blocks.plainText: A “homeowner” is a person or persons who:

blocks.html: (a)    owns a condominium homeownership affordable housing unit and occupies such condominium homeownership affordable housing unit in accordance with owner occupancy requirements set forth in the guidelines; or
blocks.plainText: (a) owns a condominium homeownership affordable housing unit and occupies such condominium homeownership affordable housing unit in accordance with owner occupancy requirements set forth in the guidelines; or

blocks.html: (b)    owns shares in a cooperative corporation, holds a proprietary lease for a homeownership affordable housing unit owned by such cooperative corporation and occupies such homeownership affordable housing unit in accordance with owner occupancy requirements set forth in the guidelines.
blocks.plainText: (b) owns shares in a cooperative corporation, holds a proprietary lease for a homeownership affordable housing unit owned by such cooperative corporation and occupies such homeownership affordable housing unit in accordance with owner occupancy requirements set forth in the guidelines.

blocks.html: “Homeownership” is a form of tenure for housing, including dwelling units occupied by either the owner as a separate condominium, a shareholder in a cooperative corporation pursuant to the terms of a proprietary lease, a grandfathered tenant or an authorized subletter pursuant to the guidelines.
